stem: A study of a large drugstore chain's promotions found that each unit of gross lift came with 0.16 units of other products bought elsewhere in the store. When should such halo units be added to a promotion's incremental units?

options.text: When measuring the promotion's effect on the whole store
When measuring the uplift of the promoted product on its own
Never, because halo units are a form of cannibalisation
Only when the promotion turned out to be unprofitable
